#508 的独立合成验收。比赛状态与销售、结算状态分离，只有决策前实际获知的 scheduled 允许参与构组。没有状态证据时排除；不使用后来取消或完场的信息改写过去。

```{r}
pkgload::load_all("../packages/beidan", quiet = TRUE)
cutoff <- list(issue_id = "00123", cutoff_utc = as.POSIXct("2026-09-22 12:00:00", tz = "UTC"))
kickoff_at <- as.POSIXct("2026-09-23 04:00:00", tz = "UTC") + seq(0, by = 900, length.out = 14L)
example <- n7_make_fixture_issue("00123", kickoff_at)
inputs <- n7_read_inputs(n7_fixture_source(example), "00123")
baseline <- n7_select_match_status(inputs$fixtures, inputs$match_status, cutoff)
stopifnot(nrow(baseline$fixtures) == 14L)
knitr::kable(baseline$selected_status)
```

```{r}
future <- inputs$match_status[1, ]
future$status <- "cancelled"
future$status_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc + 1
future$available_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc + 1
changed <- dplyr::bind_rows(inputs$match_status, future)
stopifnot(identical(baseline, n7_select_match_status(inputs$fixtures, changed, cutoff)))
at_cutoff <- future
at_cutoff$status_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc
at_cutoff$available_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc
stopifnot(identical(baseline, n7_select_match_status(inputs$fixtures, dplyr::bind_rows(inputs$match_status, at_cutoff), cutoff)))
visible <- future
visible$status_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc - 1
visible$available_at <- cutoff$cutoff_utc - 1
filtered <- n7_select_match_status(inputs$fixtures, dplyr::bind_rows(inputs$match_status, visible), cutoff)
stopifnot(nrow(filtered$fixtures) == 13L, nrow(filtered$exclusions) == 1L)
knitr::kable(filtered$exclusions)
```

```{r}
empty <- n7_select_match_status(inputs$fixtures, n7_typed_empty("match_status"), cutoff)
stopifnot(nrow(empty$fixtures) == 0L, nrow(empty$exclusions) == 14L,
          identical(empty$fixtures, inputs$fixtures[0, ]))
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(check = c("14 场 scheduled 准入", "未来取消不改写历史", "cutoff 相等不可见", "已知取消排除", "无状态证据全部排除"), passed = TRUE))
```

仅用合成数据验证接口。不声称已完成真实来源状态采集；真实输入需保留实际观察时间及原始来源链接/响应。

## 验收记录

实现与函数测试由 dsh 执行；控制侧独立运行以上断言和包相关测试，并在最终 codex review 后记录命令、结论及文件哈希。

## 构组及下注计划不变性

```{r}
probabilities <- tidyr::expand_grid(fixture_id = inputs$fixtures$fixture_id, outcome = c("W", "D", "L")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(probability = rep(c(0.5, 0.3, 0.2), nrow(inputs$fixtures)))
constants <- n7_pipeline_constants(reset = TRUE)
config <- n7_allocation_configs(constants)$C
first <- n7_run_allocation(config, inputs$fixtures, probabilities, inputs$prematch_sp,
  cutoff, constants, max_reuse = 1L, max_overlap = 0L, match_status = inputs$match_status)
second <- n7_run_allocation(config, inputs$fixtures, probabilities, inputs$prematch_sp,
  cutoff, constants, max_reuse = 1L, max_overlap = 0L, match_status = changed)
stopifnot(identical(first, second))
knitr::kable(first$built$groups$group_legs)
```

## 整期读取与决策窗口分离

```{r}
multi_kickoff <- as.POSIXct(c("2026-09-23 04:00:00", "2026-09-24 04:00:00"), tz = "UTC")
multi <- n7_make_fixture_issue("00123", multi_kickoff)
source <- n7_fixture_source(multi)
original <- source
whole <- n7_read_inputs(source, "00123")
next_cutoff <- cutoff
next_cutoff$cutoff_utc <- cutoff$cutoff_utc + 86400
euro_policy <- list(members = c("c01", "c02", "c03"), missing = "error")
totals_policy <- list(companies = NULL, line = "nearest_main", watermark = "decimal")
epoch1 <- n7_prepare_epoch(whole, cutoff, euro_policy = euro_policy, totals_policy = totals_policy)
epoch2 <- n7_prepare_epoch(whole, next_cutoff, euro_policy = euro_policy, totals_policy = totals_policy)
stopifnot(nrow(whole$fixtures) == 2L, identical(source, original),
          identical(epoch1$fixtures$fixture_id, whole$fixtures$fixture_id[1]),
          identical(epoch2$fixtures$fixture_id, whole$fixtures$fixture_id[2]))
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(stage = c("整期读取", "9月22日决策", "9月23日决策"), matches = c(nrow(whole$fixtures), nrow(epoch1$fixtures), nrow(epoch2$fixtures))))
```
